structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a 10-day-old token called "toly" on PumpSwap. Its description is "Fees to @toly", meaning the pump.fun creator fees are pointed at the X handle of Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko. It sat dormant, then took about $507k of volume in the last hour against a roughly $73k market cap. It was up about 10x over 6 hours (+1057% h6, +379% h1), but at trigger it was already falling 17-26% over 5 minutes, and the price is about 88% below its all-time high (ATH price 0.000636 vs 0.000079 now). I could not find the catalyst. It may be Toly claiming or acknowledging the fees, or a post of his, but I could not confirm either. A brand-new competing "toly" coin (XL4Mg…) is on the curve with $110k of volume in the past hour, which suggests a wave of launches using Toly's name.

narrative.description: Coins that send creator fees to a famous person's X account, here Solana co-founder Toly. The recurring trigger is the person claiming the fees or replying to the coin.
narrative.why_spreading: Unverified. The sudden revival of a dormant 10-day-old coin, plus a fresh same-name launch at the same moment, points to some Toly-related event on X, possibly a fee claim, but no indexed post was found.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only same-name coin with real current volume and liquidity, and its description sends fees to @toly. It is the one being traded right now.

authenticity.evidence: There were 753 unique buyers against 592 unique sellers in 1 hour, which is broad participation. But GMGN flags 439 bundler wallets, a 0.69 bot/degen rate and 329 fresh wallets, and the creator is a serial launcher (42 tokens). No paid boosts are active.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data, and the catalyst is unknown.

structural_risks: Price is already up 10x in 6 hours and pulling back from the local top
Serial creator (42 launches) who has closed out their position
Attention could split to the new same-name coin

structured_output.counterargument: If Toly really did claim the fees or engage with the coin, a celebrity-backed fee coin can re-rate hard, and the old ATH of about $600k is 8x above here. LP is burned, mint is renounced and top-10 holders own about 24%, so a clean second leg is possible.
unknowns: The actual catalyst (Toly post or fee claim?)
